headline: United Poly releases final e-voting and scrutinizer report
hook: United Poly shareholders conclude e-voting process
summary: United Poly has filed the final report regarding the e-voting process conducted for its shareholders' meeting. The document includes the scrutinizer's findings on the resolutions passed during the session. This filing confirms the completion of the corporate governance procedure for the company's recent shareholder engagement. Retail investors can access the report on the NSE website to review the specific outcomes of the voting.
why_it_matters: Confirms formal approval of company resolutions for shareholders.

headline: United Polyfab Gujarat submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Routine filings from United Polyfab Gujarat
summary: United Polyfab Gujarat Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. These filings complete the mandatory post-AGM compliance process for the company. Retail shareholders can review the passed resolutions through the exchange filings.
why_it_matters: Standard compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price
